qualification_patch.scope: Only original-daemon idle timeout extended to 300 seconds in installation mismatch test

fixture.variant_note: source/build repeat one edit after a base; disjoint edits distinct declared sources; config varies per client; glob adds unique untracked inputs

bep_concurrency.interpretation: Concurrent in-flight commands, not proof of simultaneous CPU-running threads

build_harness_cpu_accounting.interpretation: Non-harness remainder includes clients, daemons and compiler descendants; it is not analysis CPU. Bounds do not remove sampling perturbation.

measured.daemon_cpu_endpoint_note: Process endpoints bracket scope endpoints; final PSS/CPU sampling follows build-only scope freeze. Raw sample timing bounds this skew.
measured.exit_observation_note: Independent blocking waiters observe exits and freeze scope counters; timestamps are user-space observations, not kernel exit instants.

metric_notes: Scope memory.peak includes fixture creation and serial preparation.
Sampled daemon PSS includes initial/final reads and is not retained heap or whole-scope memory.
Build-only scope CPU freezes before final PSS sampling, info, BEP parsing, hashes and behavior checks.
End-to-end includes those checks; final shutdown/source checks are outside both windows.
Sample read CPU is diagnostic; JSON/log writing remains in raw scope CPU. No observer subtraction.

Process-wide Python CPU brackets bound all sampler/waiter/logger/control threads inside the build scope window; derived remainder bounds are diagnostics, not analysis CPU or a replacement gate metric.
Matched sampling-overhead qualifications remain required: CPU accounting cannot undo scheduling, cache or kernel-lock perturbation.
Native is the current implementation bundle including action coalescing and different modules/interner policy.
